title: Linda
intro: Linda is 31 years old, single, outspoken and very bright. She majored in philosophy. As a student she was deeply concerned with issues of discrimination and social justice, and also participated in anti-nuclear demonstrations.
question: Which is more probable?

options.text: Linda is a bank teller and is active in the feminist movement.

debrief: Every feminist bank teller is a bank teller, so the second option can never be more probable than the first. 85% of participants nevertheless chose it, because the added detail makes the description more representative of Linda.
